scope: Every generated route inspected by commercial-pattern, fragment-link, offer-binding, schema/metadata and preservation checks. Pattern matches below read in full. This is not a claim of manual visual inspection of every page.

findings.text: The model cannot earn back an upfront cost when the monthly amount left is zero or negative. A percentage return is undefined when total website cost is zero.
findings.reason: Correct mathematical explanation when the denominator is zero; not an unresolved template value.

findings.text: What can be exported, and what requires the platform to keep running?
findings.reason: Ordinary platform-continuity question; not the retired Keep Running plan name.

findings.text: Fictitious city subdivision records and undefined subdivision water-area placeholders used to fill the Census hierarchy are excluded; the actual cities remain in the incorporated-place inventory.
findings.reason: Census hierarchy explanation retained from reviewed geographic content.

findings.text: Barrios, barrios-pueblo and subbarrios are legal subdivisions without separate functioning governments; undefined subdivision areas are excluded. Municipio population estimates use the separate Puerto Rico estimates series and are not CDP populations.
findings.reason: Puerto Rico Census geography explanation; not an unresolved template value.

findings.text: A customer may know what they hope to keep running without knowing which system to request. Your electrical-service page can make that a useful starting point and preserve unknowns for the electrician’s review.
findings.reason: Electrical-service customer scenario; ordinary phrase unrelated to a monthly plan.

findings.text: 03 Identify the other responsible providers Explain the actual boundary with the customer's IT provider, general contractor or equipment team. Keep a useful existing contact and handoff question with the inquiry. Staff can then review who handles active equipment and other outstanding tasks rather than building a proposal on an undefined promise to change the whole network.
findings.reason: Supported scope caution in a local example; not an unresolved template value.

findings.text: 01 Reserve preparation and cleanup time Ask for the requested room, event and complete period of use. Hanson Nature Center includes setup and cleanup in the reserved hours. A two-hour meeting with an hour of preparation therefore needs more than a two-hour reservation; departure work also belongs in the requested schedule.
findings.reason: Venue rental source describes occupancy time; not studio internal labor budgets.

findings.text: Hanson Nature Center’s rental agreement brings together reserved hours, public use, conditional AV equipment and an in-person staff meeting. These requirements make a complete preparation guide more useful than an event-date form alone.
findings.reason: Venue rental source summary; not studio labor economics.

findings.text: 01 Put seasonal conditions beside the choice Okemah’s lake page, checked October 27, 2026, offers $400 monthly water-and-electric RV camping off-peak only and starts peak season at Memorial Day. Its season-ending wording stops at “Labor,” without a complete date. A fictional May 15–June 14 stay crosses the stated start: the monthly arrangement cannot be assumed to continue unchanged. Staff must confirm the applicable dates, rate and site; the in-season limit remains fourteen days at one site in thirty.
findings.reason: Dated, sourced local RV-camping example; not a studio service price.

findings.text: 01 Show the whole occupied period Ask for delivery, setup, guest-event, cleanup and final departure times in one outline. Explain which activities must fit within reserved hours and who handles cleaning. A party ending at the rental finish should prompt a revised cleanup plan before the request appears complete.
findings.reason: Venue-use planning example; not studio labor economics.

findings.text: Four Springs House's December 2022 rental guide includes delivery, setup and cleanup within reserved hours, limits use to approved rooms and describes a catering kitchen with food ready on arrival. It also notes weather-dependent outdoor use. The dated guide is a planning reference requiring current confirmation.
findings.reason: Dated venue rental source summary; not studio labor economics.

findings.text: 02 Distinguish day visitors from overnight campers Explain the approved visiting-dog instructions separately from camping-pet restrictions. Give uncertain vehicle or equipment plans a contact route before travel rather than inventing a numerical limit for an undefined large-RV rule.
findings.reason: Explicitly avoids inventing a numerical vehicle rule absent from the source.
